title: 第15章 他的陷阱第16章 谁逼迫谁
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
沈云熠吓得浑身一抖，整个身子险些摔下去。
“师兄你干嘛！
吓到我了！”
“修真界第一炼气会被我一句话吓到？”
林端面无表情，“哇哦，我好荣幸。”
“阴阳怪气什么！”
沈云熠嘟嚷了一句。
“回答我的问题，你干了什么？”
“你不都见了吗！
明知故问也不嫌掉价！”
沈云熠冷哼一声，“大半夜不回去烧丹，守在师弟家门口？林端，你可真行！”
“不心虚你也不会吓成那样。”
林端摇了摇头，叮嘱道，“玩闹可以，但别闹大了，大家脸上都不好看——拿着。”
说着，他将手中的传送符递给沈云熠，这才是他这么晚还来这里的原因。
沈云熠什么都大手大脚，尤其喜欢用传送符。
不分场地，不分时间，在他人面前随心所欲的离开，接受他人羡慕嫉妒的视线从来都是他最喜欢的事。
至于消耗飞快的宝贵符纸……不是有大师兄操心吗？
他可是师尊最看重的小弟子。
不过现在不是了。
而且那人还有可能是他想要的……

“别乱想乱讲，既入了门，便是我们的亲师妹，你也该知道，她为什么入门，总该和我们是一样的理由。”
林端侧过身，余光瞥见沈云熠飘扬的发带，动作一顿，皱眉道，“戴你该戴的去。”
沈云熠下意识抬手，见他要走，忙问：“你给我送了，她呢？”
“她？”
林端一怔，差点没反应过来他口中的她是谁，略一思索，淡淡道，“她一张都没有用过，一张也没有用过。”
她这几日，天天靠自己的腿生爬上这凌云峰？
沈云熠张了张嘴，却是哑然。
他该说什么，能说什么？
劝人多用资源这事，林端不会做，颜桐不管旁事，一门心思斩妖除魔。
总不能他同颜筝说，以后堵他，别生生爬了，连他这个主人也没爬过几次，直接用传送符就行？
沈云熠扫了眼颜筝先前站过的地方，冷哼一声。
不管了……装什么节俭！
只是恍惚之际，他又庆幸计划提前到明日，起码颜筝可以少爬一天。
颜筝也就是不知道沈云熠心中所想，不然早要骂娘了！
沈云熠早就知道她在那里守他，还一连守了好多天，全当不知道，故意不回来也就算了，颜筝找他也不是什么好事。
他布了计谋要整一整颜筝，竟然还要颜筝谢他？
content_en:
Shen Yunyi was so frightened that he almost fell down.
"Brother, what are you doing!
It scared me! "
"Will the number one Qi refiner in the world of cultivation be frightened by my words?"
Lin Duan had no expression on his face, "Wow, I'm so honored."
"What a weird thing!"
Shen Yunyi muttered.
"Answer my question, what did you do?"
"Haven't you seen everything?
Even if you ask questions even if you know the truth, the price will drop! "
Chen Yunyi snorted coldly, "You don't go back to burn pills in the middle of the night and stay at the door of your junior brother's house? Lin Duan, you are really good!"
"You wouldn't be so scared if you didn't feel guilty."
Lin Duan shook his head and warned, "It's okay to have fun, but don't make it too big. It won't look good on everyone's faces - take it."
With that said, he handed the teleportation talisman in his hand to Shen Yunyi. This was the reason why he came here so late.
Shen Yunyi is lavish on everything, especially using teleportation charms.
Regardless of the venue or time, leaving as he pleases in front of others and accepting the envious and jealous eyes of others has always been his favorite thing.
As for the precious talismans that are being consumed so quickly... isn't it the senior brother who has to worry about it?
He is Master's most valued disciple.
But not anymore.
And that person might be the one he wants...
"Don't think and talk nonsense. Now that she has entered the school, she is our own junior sister. You should also know that the reason why she entered the school should be the same as ours."
Lin Duan turned sideways and caught a glimpse of Chen Yunyi's flying hairband from the corner of his eye. He paused and frowned, "Wear what you should wear."
Shen Yunyi raised her hand subconsciously. Seeing that he was about to leave, she quickly asked: "You gave it to me, where is she?"
"She?"
Lin Duan was stunned and almost didn't realize who she was in his mouth. After thinking about it for a moment, he said calmly, "She has never used any of them. She has never used any of them."
In the past few days, has she climbed up Lingyun Peak on her own legs every day?
Shen Yunyi opened his mouth, but was speechless.
What should he say? What could he say?
Lin Duan didn't know how to persuade people to use more resources. Yan Tong ignored other things and focused on slaying demons.
He couldn't tell Yan Zheng to stop him from crawling in the future. Even his master had never crawled a few times, so he could just use the teleportation talisman?
Shen Yunyi glanced at the place where Yan Zheng had stood before and snorted coldly.
No matter what... you are pretending to be frugal!
Just as he was in a daze, he was glad that the plan had been advanced to tomorrow, at least Yan Zheng could save one day of climbing.
Yan Zheng just didn't know what Shen Yunyi was thinking, otherwise she would have scolded her!
Shen Yunyi had known for a long time that she was guarding him there, and she had been guarding him for many days in a row. He pretended not to know and just didn't come back on purpose. It was not a good thing for Yan Zheng to find him.
He had laid out a plan to punish Yan Zheng, but he still wanted Yan Zheng to thank him?
